description: This Java class 'JavaSyntaxChecker' reads JSON files containing code snippets, cleans and wraps them for syntax checking using JavaParser, and outputs syntax validation results.

classes.name: JavaSyntaxChecker
classes.description: Main class that performs syntax checking of Java code snippets read from a JSON file.

classes.name: CodeSnippet
classes.description: Data class representing a code snippet with its file path, language, and code content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads code snippets, performs syntax validation, and outputs results.

methods.name: removeImports
methods.description: Removes import statements from a code string.

methods.name: cleanSnippet
methods.description: Prepares code snippets for parsing by removing imports and wrapping code if necessary.

methods.name: readCodeSnippets
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a list of CodeSnippet objects from a JSON file.
